classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutorily relevant determination that Canada has taken the measures necessary to comply with the Agreement; the legal consequence occurs upon this determination, notwithstanding any subsequent implementation.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that Canada has taken measures necessary to comply with the obligations of the United States-Canada Free-Trade Agreement

classifications.rationale: The President mandates the Secretary of State to take a later diplomatic act—exchanging notes—that will provide for the Agreement’s legally consequential entry into force on the specified date.
classifications.evidence: I hereby direct the Secretary of State to exchange notes with the Government of Canada providing for the entry into force, on January 1, 1989, of the Agreement
